reason: The lab report behind the QR code and the batch number on the box are what get me, I almost never see that on TikTok Shop. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy and the empty-box refund makes it low risk.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone might be fine, but I'm not sure it's better.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing the actual lab report for a batch and explaining why bisglycinate alone is enough would seal it. If the first box were over $30 I would skip.
